published_source: Article (Management Science 72(4), 2026) Table 11 Panel B, column (1), EVerify: 0.046 with z = 4.91, Observations 1,244,747; published_se = coef/z. Also in the authors' shipped output data/t11b.csv. Authors' call (2. stata code.do lines 345-358: csdid y1, ivar(id) time(cyear) gvar(event); estat simple; y1 = ln(1 + tri_all)) re-run in Stata 16.1 with csdid 1.81 on data/csdid_all_pub.dta: ATT 0.0456283 (SE 0.0092838, z 4.91), N 1,244,747, 'Will use observations with Pair balanced'. Log: scratchpad/stata/t02310.log.
replication_status: exact (Stata csdid on the shipped file reproduces the printed coefficient and N; R hand implementation of csdid's pair-balanced cells with never-treated controls and cell-count weights gives 0.0456283, scratchpad/meta4/csdid_hand_02310.R)
notes: Reported modern estimator: csdid y1, ivar(id) time(cyear) gvar(event) followed by estat simple (2. stata code.do lines 345-358), csdid defaults (never-treated controls, doubly-robust IPW without covariates = simple 2x2 DiD of means, unit-level clustering). Sample: all states; gvar = passage year of the first mandate of either type (GA/NC recoded to 2006, SC/UT to 2008, their later universal-mandate passage years kept in the sample); cohorts 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2014; 73,961 never-treated units (RI coded never-treated, its 2009-2010 public-mandate rows are in the control group). Shipped file has only id, cyear, event, tri_all (no state variable), so clustering follows the authors' csdid (unit level); the published_coef is the authors' CSA estimate, the pipeline TWFE is the plain unit + year FE regression on the same sample (no chemical-by-year FE, as in csdid). gvar = passage year; passage-year rows are deleted so 1{cyear >= event} switches on the year after passage, the same timing as the paper's TWFE indicator; CSA base period = passage year - 1. AUTHORS' CSA SETTINGS (PROTOCOL 5b Hull alignment (c)): csdid defaults, i.e. NEVER-treated controls (csa_control_group = 'nevertreated'; with notyet the same call gives 0.0390972), no covariates, simple aggregation, and pair-balanced cells on the unbalanced panel (units observed in both g-1 and t; the simple ATT weights each post cell by the number of cohort-g units in that cell), hence csa_cells = 'pairs'. csdid's SE is clustered at the unit (id) level, whereas the table note says state; the printed z matches the unit-clustered analytic SE.
